title: Friuli-Venezia Giulia's Pump Prices Keep Climbing — Now Above the National Average
dek: Seven straight days of gains put Benzina and Gasolio in Italy's northeast ahead of the national self-service average.
body: In Friuli-Venezia Giulia, self-service Benzina is averaging €2.0148 per litre and Gasolio €2.2474, as of July 27. Both sit above the national self-service averages of €1.9948 and €2.2089 — a premium of roughly two cents on gasoline and nearly four cents on diesel for drivers filling up in the region.

The region has posted seven consecutive days of increases for both fuels: Benzina self-service rose from €1.9800 to €2.0148 (+1.8%) between July 21 and July 27, while Gasolio climbed from €2.1703 to €2.2474 (+3.6%) over the same stretch. Of the 520 stations registered in Friuli-Venezia Giulia, 468 reported prices on the latest day — a roughly 90% reporting rate that points to an active local network even as costs tick upward.

Surfacing this kind of day-by-day, region-by-region detail for all 20 of Italy's regions only works because the underlying dashboard rebuilds itself every day, pulling fresh MIMIT data, recalculating trends, and publishing automatically — no analyst re-opening a spreadsheet each morning. Fuel Dashboard is built with Claude Code, which is exactly the kind of task that turns a once-a-week manual chore into a live, self-maintaining data product.

Today's Fuel Dashboard spotlight: Friuli-Venezia Giulia, where self-service diesel has jumped 3.6% in just seven days and both Benzina and Gasolio now sit above Italy's national average.

Fuel Dashboard is a free, self-updating site that tracks gas and diesel prices across all 20 Italian regions, pulling directly from the official MIMIT feed every day. No manual data entry, no stale spreadsheet — it rebuilds itself automatically each morning. Take a look: https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/

This project is also a small case study in what's possible right now with AI coding tools. The entire pipeline — data ingestion, trend analysis, region rotation, article generation, and site deployment — was built with Claude Code instead of a manually maintained Excel file. What used to take a recurring block of someone's time each day now runs unattended, and the result is a richer, more current product than a spreadsheet could ever be.
